Hello !

I have like an increasing problem of drying marks on my recent holograms, it seems correlated to the amount of flo I'm using in the flo bath, but if I don't add any flo I have marks aswell.

Could it be related to "maybe" old chemistry ? I see my developer bath has grown some little filaments inside (silver?), would these attach to the gelatin and cause "relief" which would then give these drying marks ?

Anyone experienced the same already ?

![IMG_4465.JPG](https://holographyforum.org/forum/download/file.php?id=7131)

posts.author: Steven
posts.content_md:
I have not worked with silver halide chemistry for nearly thirty years, but I used to use a good quality window squeegee after the final rinse.

If done properly, you should not have any droplets on the emulsion surface.

I was using the Ilford red sensitized holo film at the time and a rehalogenating bleach process.

Steven.
